# Slash commands (generated)

Every command the cockpit and the classic REPL accept, projected from
`COMMAND_REGISTRY` (`internal/commands/registry.go`) — the same table that drives the
composer palette and `/help`, so this cannot describe a command that does not exist
or omit one that does.

Most commands work in both surfaces — the cockpit renders them as command cards (and
may focus a deck view), while `--classic` prints them to the console. Two do not:
`/login` opens an in-place sheet in the cockpit but only prints guidance in classic
mode (use the `login` subcommand there), and `/approvals` is cockpit-only, since
session approvals are a cockpit concept.

**Do not edit this file** — it is regenerated and diffed in CI.

## 26 commands

| Command | What it does |

| `/status` | backend, MCP, project, session, tier |

| `/quit` | exit (aliases: /q, /exit) |
